assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias.
CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
CPT 93229 is medically necessary to address the documented clinical indications.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I25.10, and I34.0.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
